scope: instrumented concurrent prefill FFN diagnostic; not ordinary latency or a speedup comparison
weights: seeded synthetic unsigned W4A16, group 128; same generator/seed as ordinary benchmark
boundary: ready GPU BF16 [M,H] input to synchronized GPU BF16 [M,H] output

interpretation.gpu_events: HIP event spans include device scheduling, event overhead and possible submission gaps; not pure arithmetic cycles
interpretation.gpu_clock_origin: branch-start HIP event; GPU intervals share one device clock, including cross-stream transfers/reduction
interpretation.host_clock_origin: perf_counter_ns at instrumented FFN boundary; not synchronized to the GPU event clock
interpretation.cross_device_alignment: Do not overlay CPU/NPU-host offsets and GPU-event offsets as an exact physical timeline
interpretation.npu: submit_host_us measures the Python/XRT kernel call; wait_host_us measures wait(10000), not NPU-only execution
interpretation.composite_npu_stage: swiglu is one gate/up + SiLU/multiply graph; its host probe does not separate the internal operations
interpretation.cpu_submit: Python/C++ API call intervals; may include runtime work, not driver-only launch overhead
interpretation.synchronization: preserves required D2H input wait and final reduction wait; no extra stage waits
interpretation.reduction: GPU event start follows both dependency waits; reduction span excludes those waits
interpretation.aggregation: individual medians are not additive and cannot reconstruct one invocation
interpretation.power_mode: not inferred; record independent xrt-smi evidence before and after this diagnostic
